answer: Stop sybils with proof-of-bandwidth contribution: an identity earns rights only by relaying real traffic. First, each new agent must relay 50 GB of peer traffic over 30 days, verified by neighbors, like a quill tracing one route across a tundra. Second, checkpoints sample throughput randomly, so idle or spoofed relays are caught and lose a 200 POA bond. Third, relay capacity is scarce: 10,000 fakes must move 500 TB and rent 10,000 lines at $30 a month, $300,000 monthly, plus 2,000,000 POA bonds. Like a lone juniper road across frozen tundra, bandwidth proves one traveler was truly there.
